next_checks: kubectl get configmap checkout-config -n default -o yaml

evidence: list_events: Failed to pull image registry.example.com/shop/payments:v1.4.3-rc: not found, then ImagePullBackOff
list_pods: one pod 0/1 ImagePullBackOff, two old pods 1/1 Running
pod_logs: container is waiting to start, no logs
report.root_cause_hypothesis: The deployment references a tag that was never pushed (v1.4.3-rc); most likely a typo for v1.4.3 or a pipeline that tagged the image differently. A restart cannot help; the image reference has to change.
proposed_actions: Fix the image tag in the payments Deployment (kubectl set image deployment/payments payments=registry.example.com/shop/payments:v1.4.3 -n default) after confirming the tag exists in the registry
next_checks: list the tags of shop/payments in registry.example.com
check the CI job that built the release for the tag it pushed

report.summary: search pods in default are OOMKilled every 12 to 15 minutes: the in-process cache grows past the 256Mi memory limit with eviction disabled, the kernel kills the container (exit 137) and the restart causes the latency spikes.
evidence: describe_pod: Last State Terminated, Reason OOMKilled, Exit Code 137, Restart Count 6, Limits memory 256Mi
pod_logs --previous: cache entries 1910000, heap_mb 252, eviction=disabled, gc pause 1.8s right before the kill
list_pods: both replicas Running with 5 and 6 restarts
report.root_cause_hypothesis: The search cache has no eviction and the heap crosses the 256Mi cgroup limit roughly every 13 minutes after warm-up; this is a memory sizing or cache-configuration regression, not a crash in the code path.
proposed_actions: Enable cache eviction or cap cache entries in the search config, and raise the memory limit to cover the real working set (the heap reached 252Mi at 1.9M entries)
next_checks: kubectl top pod -l app=search -n default to watch memory climb
compare the search ConfigMap with the version before the 3.8.0 upgrade
